signal: Vividly raised a $30M Series B led by Centana to scale its engineering and product teams and deepen AI in CPG trade promotion.

email.body1:
Antonietta, saw Vividly closed its $30M Series B to push AI deeper into CPG trade promotion.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market brands in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Vividly off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Antonietta, quick follow-up for Vividly.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Vividly needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Antonietta, last bit of proof for Vividly.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Vividly's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Antonietta, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a raise, timing is everything, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a CPG sales motion? I'll tailor it to Vividly either way.
